questions.q: ___ the opposition of local residents, the new road was built.
questions.why: «Попри» + іменник — *Notwithstanding* (без *of*). *Notwithstanding of* — помилка; *Nevertheless* і *Even so* — між реченнями, не перед іменником.

questions.q: The company cut its prices, ___ attracting thousands of new customers.
The risks are considerable. ___, we have decided to go ahead.
questions.why: «Проте» між реченнями — *Nonetheless,*. *Notwithstanding* — перед іменником; *Whereas* — протиставлення двох фактів в одному реченні; *Whereupon* — «після чого».

questions.q: He insulted the referee, ___ he was sent off.
questions.why: «Після чого» + речення — *whereupon he was sent off*. *thereby* — + *-ing*; *notwithstanding* — + іменник; *henceforth* — «відтепер».

questions.q: Scientists have discovered a ___ unknown species of frog.
We want to reduce plastic waste. To ___ end, we have banned plastic bags.
questions.why: Сталий вираз — *To this end*. *To that's end*, *To which end*, *To the end* — неправильні або інший зміст.

questions.q: ___, all visitors must sign in at reception.
questions.why: «Відтепер» — *Henceforth*. *Hitherto* — «досі»; *Whereupon* і *Thereby* — не стоять так на початку.

questions.q: Two members, ___ Smith and Jones, voted against.
questions.why: «А саме» (перелік) — *namely*. *that is to* і *i.e. to* — зайве *to*; *such* — «такі як» без *as*.

questions.q: Some people work better in the morning; ___, others are more productive at night.
The roads were icy, ___ the large number of accidents.
questions.why: «Звідси» + іменник — *hence the large number*. *thus it* — неграматично; *therefore* — потребує речення; *whereby* — «за яким».
«Відповідно, тому» між реченнями — *accordingly*. *according* без *to* — неповне; *accordance* — іменник; *in accordance* — потребує *with*.

questions.q: Exercise strengthens the body. By the same ___, reading strengthens the mind.
questions.why: Сталий вираз — *By the same token*. *way*, *manner*, *reason of* — неправильні слова в цьому виразі.

questions.q: The new system saves time, ___ (thus / reduce) costs.
The weather ___, the ceremony went ahead outdoors.
She criticised her boss in public and, in so ___, lost her job.
The elderly, that ___ to say, people over 65, are most at risk.

answer: Notwithstanding the cost the project went ahead
Notwithstanding the cost, the project went ahead
